system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
My Spotify has been accessed by someone. Music randomly stops playing or starts playing music I have not heard off. There is also music in my "recently played" that I haven't. I've changed my password 3 times and clicked "Sign Out Everywhere". Still not helped.

PREDICTED INTENT: login_access

PRECEDENTS:

[2560562] (similarity 0.79, intent login_access)
  past customer: my spotify keeps logging me out as soon as i log in, idk what to do
  spotify replied: Hey there, help's here! Does restarting your device help? Keep us posted

[647115] (similarity 0.78, intent login_access)
  past customer: keep getting the message "Spotify has paused cos your account is being used elsewhere" I've logged out of all my accounts but it's still happening. Whoever is using my account is listening to Xmas music in November, unforgivable! <link>
  spotify replied: Hey Tom! We're sorry to hear that. Check out <link> for what to do next

[1688960] (similarity 0.75, intent login_access)
  past customer: I keep getting logged out of Spotify on Chrome - happened around 4 or 5 times this afternoon. Any ideas?
  spotify replied: Hey Jack! Can you send the device and operating system you're using? We'll see what we can do

[859897] (similarity 0.72, intent login_access)
  past customer: why am I unable to play ANY songs on spotify? I've tried logging out and logging back in, nothing is helping
  spotify replied: Hey Celia, that doesn't sound good. Can you let us know what device, operating system, and Spotify version you're using?

[1105814] (similarity 0.71, intent login_access)
  past customer: Someone logged in to my Spotify account and has been using it for forever. So I canceled my subscription and left them a little note. <link>
  spotify replied: Hey, we're sorry to hear that. Check out <link> for what to do next

Draft the reply as JSON.
